title: A nontrivial line bundle with a trivial square sum
promptMarkdown: For the Möbius line bundle described in the lesson, prove that it has no nowhere-zero continuous section. Construct a smooth global frame of its Whitney sum with itself. Explain why the pullback under the double covering $S^1\to S^1$, $e^{it}\mapsto e^{2it}$, is trivial.
hintLadder: Lift a section to the real line.
Seek a $2\times2$ rotation matrix that changes sign after $2\pi$.
Follow the gluing map twice around the target.
